motive.quote: So he killed Hotta in revenge for having humiliated her.

evidence.quote: But her body was never found.

motive.zhHans: 所以他为了报复她受到的羞辱而杀死了 Hotta。动画中柯南心想：「原来如此，是这么回事啊！」这一幕更长，因为加入了第862集的回忆画面。
motive.en: So he killed Hotta in revenge for having humiliated her. The scene where Conan thinks: "I see, that's how it is!" is longer in the anime, because flashbacks of episode 862 are shown.

method.zhHans: 动机是 Hotta 用他已故妹妹的尸体来做节目。毛利小五郎在电话中被骗，要与「灵魂侦探」Hotta Gaito 一起上电视节目，电话里的人告诉他将与冲野洋子一起出演节目。动画中还出现了毛利小五郎与冲野洋子乔装打扮的画面，以及写着「解决悬案！！」的横幅。
method.en: The motive was that Hotta used his late sister's corpse for his show. When Kogoro is on the phone being tricked into appearing in a TV show with "Soul Detective" Hotta Gaito, the person on the phone tells him he'll star in a show with Yoko Okino. In the anime, a visual with Kogoro and Yoko Okino in disguise and a banner with "Solve the cold case!!" written on it are shown.

evidence.zhHans: 但她的尸体一直没有被找到。后来 Hotta 在山里拍节目（很可能与一桩失踪案有关，柯南和毛利小五郎在出租车上讨论过），「找到」了尸体，并声称「感应」到了她的灵魂。Kokuri 意识到 Hotta 一定早就发现了妹妹的尸体，但他没有向警方报案，而是把她埋了起来，用来拍节目。
evidence.en: But her body was never found. Later Hotta was making a show in the mountain (most likely in connection with a missing person case, that Conan and Kogorō discussed in the taxi) and 'found' the body claiming to have 'felt' its spirit. Kokuri realized that Hotta must have found his sister's body a long time ago, but instead of reporting it to the police, he had buried it to use it in his show.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Sanpei Kokuri。动机是 Hotta 用他已故妹妹的尸体来做节目。几年前 Kokuri 的妹妹因失恋在山里自杀。但她的尸体一直没有被找到。后来 Hotta 在山里拍节目（很可能与一桩失踪案有关，柯南和毛利小五郎在出租车上讨论过），「找到」了尸体，并声称「感应」到了她的灵魂。Kokuri 意识到 Hotta 一定早就发现了妹妹的尸体，但他没有向警方报案，而是把她埋了起来，用来拍节目。所以他为了报复她受到的羞辱而杀死了 Hotta。
resolution.en: The culprit is Sanpei Kokuri. The motive was that Hotta used his late sister's corpse for his show. A few years ago Kokuri's sister committed suicide in the mountains due to a break-up. But her body was never found. Later Hotta was making a show in the mountain (most likely in connection with a missing person case, that Conan and Kogorō discussed in the taxi) and 'found' the body claiming to have 'felt' its spirit. Kokuri realized that Hotta must have found his sister's body a long time ago, but instead of reporting it to the police, he had buried it to use it in his show. So he killed Hotta in revenge for having humiliated her.
